h1: Karachi SEO and GEO: get found in Google and in AI answers
intro: Our SEO and GEO service gets Karachi companies found when buyers search, whether they type in English, Urdu or Roman Urdu, look for a business near them in Clifton or Gulshan, or ask an AI assistant. We fix the technical basics, build local visibility, write answer-first pages and make sure ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overview answers describe you correctly.

p: Search in Karachi is split three ways. Corporate and B2B buyers search in English. Many consumers search in Roman Urdu, typing Urdu words in Latin letters. Others search in Urdu script, often by voice. A clinic, a car showroom or a lawn brand that only targets one of those is invisible to the other two.

Searches are also hyperlocal. People look for a dentist in DHA Phase 6, a furniture shop on Shahrah-e-Faisal or a caterer in North Nazimabad, and Google answers with the map pack before any website. Then the buyer taps the WhatsApp or call button. Good SEO Karachi customers respond to is built around those habits.

sections.h: Showing up in AI answers, not only Google
p: Buyers increasingly ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Google AI Overview for recommendations: which freight forwarder in Karachi handles reefer containers, which hospital has a good cardiology unit, which software house builds banking apps. These assistants pull from your website, your listings and what others write about you.

We make sure the facts are clear and consistent everywhere, write pages that answer the questions buyers actually ask, and check how each major assistant describes you today. When an assistant gets you wrong, we trace where the wrong information comes from and fix the source.

p: Most SEO Karachi audits turn up the same handful of issues, and fixing them is often the fastest win available.
list: Duplicate or unverified Google Business Profiles for the same branch, splitting reviews and confusing Google.
Different phone numbers and addresses on the website, Facebook, directories and maps.
Service pages that exist only as images or sliders, so there is no text for Google or AI assistants to read.
A single page trying to rank for every area of the city instead of focused location pages for the areas you serve.
No tracking on WhatsApp and call buttons, so nobody knows which searches produce enquiries.

faqs.q: What is the difference between SEO and GEO?
faqs.a: SEO gets your website ranking in Google and Bing. GEO, generative engine optimisation, gets your business found and described correctly by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overview. They share a lot of ground: clear pages, consistent facts and outside mentions help both. We run them together in one plan.

faqs.q: Do you do SEO in Urdu?
faqs.a: Yes. We research and target Urdu script and Roman Urdu searches as well as English, because Karachi customers use all three. Urdu pages get proper right-to-left layout and their own URLs. We decide which pages need Urdu versions based on search data, rather than translating the whole site by default.

faqs.q: How long does SEO take to work in Karachi?
faqs.a: Technical and Google Business Profile fixes usually show first. Ranking new pages for competitive searches depends on your site's history and competition. We set expectations for each search term in the plan and report progress monthly, including calls and WhatsApp clicks, not just rankings.

faqs.q: Can you get our branches into the Google map pack?
faqs.a: We can give each branch the best chance. That means a complete and accurate Google Business Profile, the right categories, consistent address details across the web, regular photos and posts, and a steady flow of genuine reviews with replies. Nobody can promise a position, but these steps are what Google rewards.

faqs.q: What do you need from us to start?
faqs.a: Access to Google Search Console, Google Analytics and your Google Business Profile, plus a list of your branches and the services that bring in the most revenue. With that, we run an audit and send a written plan within 5 to 7 days. After that we meet on video when it suits you and report in writing every month.

Each month you get a plain-language report: what we did, rankings for the searches that matter, organic traffic, Google Business Profile calls and direction requests, WhatsApp clicks and leads where tracking allows, plus how AI assistants currently describe you. Then we agree next month's priorities.
